subject: SCIM delta, TTL for events, and ownership handoff for Glimmer Health
messages:
From: Chris Nguyen <chris@glimmerhealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: security@glimmerhealth.com
Date: Sun, 19 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SCIM delta + RBAC ownership snapshot (Glimmer)

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call last week. To close our SIG/CAIQ evidence loop we need a small package from Redwood showing recent provisioning activity and an ownership snapshot. Specifically:

- SCIM delta for 2027-09-01 -> 2027-09-19 (adds/removes/updates)
- Role-to-user ownership mapping for active roles (CSV or XLSX)
- TTL/retention description for SCIM events and how long delta logs are retained

Can you provide the delta export and an RBAC ownership matrix by EOD Wednesday (Sep 22)? If there are sensitive artifacts we can accept a redacted export.

Appreciate it — CC’ing our security mailbox.

—Chris
Security Engineer, Glimmer Health
[Attachment: request-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Chris Nguyen <chris@glimmerhealth.com>
Cc: security@glimmerhealth.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + RBAC ownership snapshot (Glimmer)

Hi Chris — thanks, we can do this. Quick clarifying questions before we produce the exports:

1) Do you want the raw SCIM delta (line-level adds/replace/delete) or an aggregated change summary? We can supply both but the raw delta is larger.
2) For the RBAC ownership matrix: should we include service accounts and delegated admins or only human user principals?
3) On retention: do you need a statement of current retention policy (what we retain in the control plane) or an exported event TTL table showing timestamps for each delta row?

Plan: we’ll assemble a redacted CSV for the delta and a role-ownership XLSX. I’ll loop in Jordan to run the exports and Rishi to validate role mappings. Expect a shared Drive folder link and the two attachments by EOD Wed (Sep 22).

If anything is time-sensitive earlier, let me know.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: signing-request.txt (txt)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Action: run SCIM delta export + ownership matrix for Glimmer Health — due Wed EOD

Jordan / Rishi — putting the ask from Glimmer below. Deliverables:

- SCIM delta CSV covering 2027-09-01 through 2027-09-19. Include: timestamp, operation (add/replace/delete), user_id, email, role_ids, source (provisioning/scim/api). Redact user emails for any accounts flagged as PII-sensitive (replace local-part with xxxx).
- RBAC ownership matrix (XLSX): columns: role_id, role_name, owner_team, owner_contact, service_account_flag, active_user_count.
- Short TTL note (1–2 paragraphs) describing how long we retain SCIM deltas in the control plane and where archived logs live.

Context: this is for SIG/CAIQ review; Glimmer requested redacted exports are acceptable. Share outputs to Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEfGh123 and attach the two files to the reply. Please validate role_name mappings against our canonical role registry before finalizing.

Jordan — can you run the export and drop the CSV into the drive? Rishi — please run the ownership extraction and sanity-check counts. Ping me with any blockers.

Thanks — Hannah

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Chris Nguyen <chris@glimmerhealth.com>, security@glimmerhealth.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SCIM delta + RBAC ownership snapshot (Glimmer) — delivery

Hi Chris (and Glimmer security),

Attached are the artifacts you requested: the redacted SCIM delta CSV and the RBAC ownership matrix. Summary below:

- Files attached: glimmer_scim_delta_0901-0919.csv (redacted emails, operations and timestamps preserved), rbac_ownership_matrix_v2.xlsx (owner_team and owner_contact columns populated).
- Retention/TTL: SCIM delta rows are available in the control plane for 90 days. We snapshot and archive deltas to our internal object store (AES-256 encrypted) on a 30-day cadence; archives are retained for 2 years for compliance.
- Notes on redaction: local-parts of user emails were replaced with xxxx for PII protection. Service accounts are flagged in the workbook; delegated admins are included.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEfGh123 (I uploaded the files and set view-only for your security mailbox).

Attachments:
- glimmer_scim_delta_0901-0919.csv (csv)
- rbac_ownership_matrix_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

If you need unredacted exports under an NDA, we can open a secure transfer and provide a scoped export. Otherwise, let me know if the redacted artifacts satisfy the SIG packet.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: glimmer_scim_delta_0901-0919.csv (csv)]
[Attachment: rbac_ownership_matrix_v2.xlsx (xlsx)]
